Verdict: **refuted=true** (high confidence).

The quote literally exists in the primary source, but the claim is an overreach/cherry-pick. The same Discussion #2496 thread contains an immediate caveat about "significant limitations in nested tmux sessions and other edge cases," and current 2026 evidence (pi-mono #2374 on Ghostty 1.3.1 + tmux 3.6a) shows Kitty graphics do NOT work in tmux out of the box — they require `allow-passthrough on`, app-side DCS passthrough wrapping, and Unicode placeholders, with known duplicate-render and pane-leakage bugs. A single anecdotal forum confirmation does not support the generalized "confirmed to work with tmux" phrasing.
